actions.description: It will remove interfering screen protector

steps: If your screen protector is peeling or has debris under it, remove it.

actions.description: It will clean moisture and debris

steps: Gently wipe the front and back with a lint-free, soft microfiber cloth or a camera lens cleaning cloth.

actions.description: It will restart and refresh your device

steps: Press and hold the Power button, then tap Restart.
Tap Restart again to confirm.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Black Screen Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Black screen issue

actions.description: It will check for physical damage

steps: Carefully inspect your phone or tablet, charger, and USB cable for any physical damage or signs of liquid exposure.
Remove any cases or accessories that might be covering the charging port or buttons.
Examine the USB connections for any corrosion or bent pins.

actions.description: It will charge the device

steps: Connect your phone or tablet to its appropriate charger and let it charge for at least 1 hour.

actions.description: It will power on the device

steps: Disconnect the phone or tablet from the charger.
Try to turn it on by pressing and holding the Power button for 15 to 20 seconds.

actions.description: It will get your device professionally repaired

steps: Contact the Customer Support Center for further assistance.

actions.description: It will force an unresponsive device restart

steps: Press and hold both the Power button and the Volume down button simultaneously for at least 20 seconds.
